hfo.text:
cheat syntax:

start a command and end commands with <>

tp(x,y,room) : sets the value of the player x and y and ROOM to the specified stuff.
smite(spriteName) : "deletes" sprite, saving their data via uri to a list of smote sprites
revive(spriteNumber) : restores data from the specified number of the list
shhh(spriteName) : hibernates sprite.
ahhh(spriteName) : wakes sprite
god mode : hides player hitbox, and sets player speed to 12, and cancels death scripts
mortal mode : sets player mode back to normal
super cheats : loads a manual pre-made save state
setVar(variable, value) : sets a global variable to a value
setVar$(variableID, value) : sets a private variable to a value
